info.title: Toll — onchain coin checks
info.description: Free reads from the chain itself. The token check reads Robinhood Chain (4663): who is behind a coin (wallets that moved together, who funded them, the dev's record, whether the liquidity can be pulled) and a plain tally of findings. The deployer's launch record and the wallet privacy check read Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) only. Information only, not advice. Each read is rate-limited per caller and site-wide. The LARP check (is there a real product behind a coin) is /api/product/ask. An MCP server with the same reads is at https://t0ll.xyz/mcp. The paid reads over x402 are listed too (/api/x402/check, /api/x402/dev, /api/x402/fresh, /api/x402/tx (the pre-sign check, POST), /api/x402/stock (Toll Markets, one stock token), /api/x402/markets/fundamentals, /api/x402/markets/insiders, /api/x402/markets/institutions (13F holders), /api/x402/markets/guidance (earnings-release guidance, AI-extracted from cited filings), /api/x402/markets/macro, /api/x402/markets/stocks (the Markets board), /api/x402/pulse (Robinhood Chain right now) and, while it is open, /api/x402/larp), charged only for a whole answer. Toll Markets (Robinhood Stock Tokens: Chainlink reference price, pools, supply, corporate actions, SEC filings, company numbers, insider trades, 13F institutional holders, earnings-release guidance, macro) is free at /api/markets/stocks, /api/markets/stock/{id}, /api/markets/fundamentals/{id}, /api/markets/insiders/{id}, /api/markets/institutions/{id}, /api/markets/guidance/{id} and /api/markets/macro within its own daily calls; its stock event feed is /api/markets/feed (a Toll key, Pro and Team). The pre-sign check is also free at POST /api/tx/check.
info.x-guidance: Free reads need no key: GET /api/check?addr=<token>&wait=1 for a coin check (any chain we read), /api/deployer?addr=<wallet> for a launcher's record, /api/product/ask?q=<token> for the LARP check. Paid over x402 with no free quota: GET /api/x402/check/{token}?chain=rh (0.005000 USD), /api/x402/dev/{wallet} (0.005000 USD), /api/x402/fresh?limit=1..20 (0.010000 USD), POST /api/x402/tx with the transaction, signature or x402 payment to check (0.005000 USD; free at POST /api/tx/check). With no payment a paid route answers 402 with what to pay; sign it and resend with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. You are charged only for a whole answer.

get.summary: Check a token on Robinhood Chain (4663)

Reads Robinhood Chain (4663); a token on another chain than Robinhood Chain answers in that chain's shape (ChainCheck). Full page: https://t0ll.xyz/check/{addr} (Robinhood Chain) or https://t0ll.xyz/{chain}/check/{addr}. Six reads a minute per caller.

get.summary: LARP check: is there a real product behind a coin (Robinhood Chain)
get.description: Reads the coin's site, posts and code, lists each thing it claims, and checks every claim against the chain and its own working parts (app, API, MCP server, x402, extension, Telegram bot, public code). The label is product found / partly found / not found / not read: a fact about what we could check, never a verdict. A check already stored answers at once (state done, with `check`). A coin nobody asked about yet is queued and read within minutes: ask again after a minute while state is queued or reading. Costs one of the free coins a day per caller (one quota with the token check); past them the answer is over_quota with the coin's paid x402 URL (https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/larp/{token}?chain=rh, 0.005 USDG, charged only for a whole answer). Answers {show: false} while the check is switched off. Six reads a minute per caller. Full page: https://t0ll.xyz/larp.

The answer is a PresignReport: typed facts read at one pinned block (approvals, transfers, the payee, the tokens), no verdict, signed by eip155:4663:0x02593abff31f4e8ec1d5c2f297a347c51ef06e5c. post.summary: Pre-sign check: ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK a transaction, signature or x402 payment before signing (Robinhood Chain)
post.description: POST what an agent is about to sign: a transaction ({chainId: 4663, from, to, data, value}), a message ({message: {kind: personal_sign | eth_sign, data}, origin}), an EIP-712 signature ({typedData}), an ERC-4337 user operation ({userOp, entryPoint}), an EIP-7702 authorizationList (alone or with the transaction), the wallet request as sent ({rpc: {method, params}}) or an x402 payment ({x402}: the 402's PaymentRequired or one accepts entry, optional agentId and registry). Checks approvals (unlimited, to a plain wallet, to a contract we do not know, to a wallet the coin's check names), transfers, the coin a swap buys (Toll's coin check) by its calibrated findings (calibration window 2026-10-13..10-29), and an x402 payTo by ERC-8478 (the seller's ERC-8004 agent wallet or a payee delegation it signed, Robinhood Chain or Base registry; the outcome in x-toll.payees[].payee8478). An ERC-8265 RiskAssessment (ethereum/ERCs PR #1753, section 7): action ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK (the worst warning: critical = BLOCK, high or medium = WARN), warnings [{ code, severity, message }] worst first, scanners [{ provider: Toll (ERC-8004 agent #20030 on chain 4663), verdict, url }], and Toll's facts under x-toll (what was decoded, the coin a swap buys, the x402 seller). Robinhood Chain (4663) only: another chainId is a 400. Calldata it cannot read is WARN, never ALLOW; a coin still being read is WARN with retry_after_s, never ALLOW. It simulates the transaction at the current block (balance changes, approvals, revert; in x-toll.simulation) and can compare it with an optional intent (x-toll.intent). A failed simulation is reported as not read, never ALLOW; a transaction without from cannot be simulated and is WARN. It reads personal_sign and eth_sign messages (Sign-In with Ethereum included), any EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, and any other named field by field), ERC-4337 user operations, and multicall, Safe and smart-account batches leaf by leaf, each warning with its path; for a signature, what it lets someone take is in x-toll.take (simulated at the current block, in USD where Toll has a price), and every text field of EIP-712 typed data (domain name and version, message strings) is scanned for instructions aimed at AI agents (typed-data-text-injection). A single-pool Uniswap v4 swap off the coin's main pool is quoted on the main pool (swap-route-worse when that pays more than 3% more). Uniswap v4 position manager calls (modifyLiquidities, its multicall, initializePool, permit) are read action by action: liquidity paid out to anyone but from is lp-take-to-other, a position minted to another wallet lp-mint-to-other. An x402 upto payment is flagged with its signed maximum, which the seller may charge in full (x402-scheme-upto); an auth-capture payment's escrow, token collector and hold are read (x402-escrow-unknown, x402-collector-mismatch). An EIP-7702 delegation to a delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN, any other is BLOCK. It reads and warns; on its own it changes nothing onchain. A contract can require it through a single-use ALLOW ticket (the ticket field, returned in x-toll.ticket; https://t0ll.xyz/agents/allow). Facts, not advice. Free: thirty a minute per caller; the coin a swap buys counts against the free coins a day (one quota with /api/check), and past them it is not read (WARN coin-over-quota, with the paid route). Paid, no daily limit: /api/x402/tx.

schema.description: What the agent is about to sign. Any of: a transaction (chainId, from, to, data, value), a message to sign (message: personal_sign or eth_sign), an EIP-712 signature (typedData), an ERC-4337 user operation (userOp, entryPoint), an EIP-7702 authorizationList (alone or with the transaction), the wallet request as sent (rpc), an x402 payment (x402, with agentId optional). Robinhood Chain (4663) only for transactions and signatures.

chainId.description: 4663 (Robinhood Chain); any other chain is refused (400). Default 4663.

from.description: the signer (optional): a swap paying out to anyone else is flagged

to.description: the contract or wallet the transaction is sent to

data.description: the calldata, hex ("0x" for a plain send)

authorizationList.description: a type-4 (EIP-7702) transaction's authorizations [{chainId, address, nonce, yParity, r, s}] (also read as authorization_list), or a signAuthorization alone (no to, no data): a delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN, any other is BLOCK eip7702-delegation

typedData.description: an EIP-712 request {domain, types, primaryType, message}: Permit, Permit2 PermitSingle / PermitBatch / PermitTransferFrom, TransferWithAuthorization, Seaport, UniswapX, or any other (named field by field); what the signature lets someone take is in x-toll.take

message.description: a message to sign (also read as signMessage). Sign-In with Ethereum is read (domain against origin, expiry); eth_sign of a hash is BLOCK

origin.description: the site or app asking for the signature (https://...), checked against a Sign-In with Ethereum domain

rpc.description: the wallet request as the agent would send it, read as the body it stands for. personal_sign [data, address], eth_sign [address, data], eth_signTypedData_v4 [address, typed data JSON], eth_sendTransaction [tx]

userOp.description: an ERC-4337 user operation (v0.6, v0.7 packed or unpacked, v0.8): sender, nonce, callData, gas fields, paymaster, signature. Its calls (execute, executeBatch, multicall, Safe) are opened and each checked with its path

entryPoint.description: the user operation's EntryPoint; one Toll does not know is a warning

x402.description: the PaymentRequired the seller's 402 sent (with accepts), or one accepts entry; optional payment (the signed payload or its authorization) and resource (the URL paid for)

agentId.description: the x402 seller's ERC-8004 agent id, when known (else the 402's extra.erc8004, else it is looked up by the resource URL's host on Robinhood Chain)

registry.description: the identity registry agentId is in, CAIP-10 (default eip155:4663:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432; Base: eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432)

intent.description: Optional: what the agent means to do. Toll compares it with the decoded call and the simulation; each difference is a warning (intent-mismatch, intent-recipient-mismatch, intent-extra-outflow, sim-outflow-undeclared), listed in x-toll.intent. Amounts are base units as decimal strings (USDG has 6 decimals).

sellToken.description: the token sent or approved: a token: its address (0x + 40 hex) or ETH, WETH or USDG

sellAmount.description: how much of sellToken leaves the signer, base units

buyToken.description: the token a swap buys: a token: its address (0x + 40 hex) or ETH, WETH or USDG

minBuy.description: the least of buyToken the swap must give, base units

maxAmount.description: the most an approve may allow, base units

tolerancePct.description: extra outflow allowed over sellAmount, in percent (default 1)

intentText.description: Optional, instead of intent: what the agent means to do in plain words, at most 300 characters (e.g. "swap 10 USDG for HOOD, send to my wallet"). Toll's AI reads it into an intent (tokens only ETH, WETH, USDG, an official Stock Token or a coin this transaction names; an address only when the text holds it), shown in x-toll.intent.understood, then compared like intent. Not read in time = a low warning intent-text-not-read. Ignored when intent is sent.
intentText.example: swap 10 USDG for HOOD, send to my wallet

ticket.description: Optional: ask for a single-use ALLOW ticket, an EIP-712 "Toll Allow" v1 signature (chain 4663) that a contract can require before it runs this exact call. Issued only for an ALLOW, or a WARN with no high or critical warning, for a transaction with from and no authorizationList; valid for 60 s; returned in x-toll.ticket, or x-toll.ticket.why when none. true = scope call, any consumer.

consumer.description: the contract that will check the ticket (default: any)

scope.description: call (default): binds to, value and data; v4swap: binds the v4 swap the transaction makes (HookrRouter swap calls)

swap.description: v4swap: the swap expected; it must equal the one the transaction makes

400.description: Not a request this check reads, or a chain other than Robinhood Chain (4663).

post.summary: Pre-sign check of a transaction, signature or x402 payment (paid, x402)
post.description: Pre-sign check: POST the transaction, message (personal_sign, eth_sign, Sign-In with Ethereum), EIP-712 signature, ERC-4337 user operation, EIP-7702 authorization or x402 payment an agent is about to sign (Robinhood Chain 4663) and get ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK with reasons, in the ERC-8265 RiskAssessment shape: approvals (unlimited, to a wallet, to an unknown contract), transfers, the coin a swap buys (Toll's coin check) and a main pool that pays more, Uniswap v4 liquidity calls, what a signature lets someone take (simulated), instructions hidden in EIP-712 text, and an x402 payTo against the seller's ERC-8004 agentWallet, upto and auth-capture terms included. An ERC-8265 RiskAssessment (ethereum/ERCs PR #1753, section 7): action ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK (the worst warning: critical = BLOCK, high or medium = WARN), warnings [{ code, severity, message }] worst first, scanners [{ provider: Toll (ERC-8004 agent #20030 on chain 4663), verdict, url }], and Toll's facts under x-toll (what was decoded, the coin a swap buys, the x402 seller). Robinhood Chain (4663) only: another chainId is a 400. Calldata it cannot read is WARN, never ALLOW; a coin still being read is WARN with retry_after_s, never ALLOW. It simulates the transaction at the current block (balance changes, approvals, revert; in x-toll.simulation) and can compare it with an optional intent (x-toll.intent). A failed simulation is reported as not read, never ALLOW; a transaction without from cannot be simulated and is WARN. It reads personal_sign and eth_sign messages (Sign-In with Ethereum included), any EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, and any other named field by field), ERC-4337 user operations, and multicall, Safe and smart-account batches leaf by leaf, each warning with its path; for a signature, what it lets someone take is in x-toll.take (simulated at the current block, in USD where Toll has a price), and every text field of EIP-712 typed data (domain name and version, message strings) is scanned for instructions aimed at AI agents (typed-data-text-injection). A single-pool Uniswap v4 swap off the coin's main pool is quoted on the main pool (swap-route-worse when that pays more than 3% more). Uniswap v4 position manager calls (modifyLiquidities, its multicall, initializePool, permit) are read action by action: liquidity paid out to anyone but from is lp-take-to-other, a position minted to another wallet lp-mint-to-other. An x402 upto payment is flagged with its signed maximum, which the seller may charge in full (x402-scheme-upto); an auth-capture payment's escrow, token collector and hold are read (x402-escrow-unknown, x402-collector-mismatch). An EIP-7702 delegation to a delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN, any other is BLOCK. It reads and warns; on its own it changes nothing onchain. A contract can require it through a single-use ALLOW ticket (the ticket field, returned in x-toll.ticket; https://t0ll.xyz/agents/allow). Facts, not advice. Paid over x402: 0.005 USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663) per call, no daily limit, charged only for a whole answer (a coin bought that is still being read is not charged). With no payment it answers 402 with the requirements; pay with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) and the same body. The same check is free at /api/tx/check within the free coins a day. schema.description: What the agent is about to sign. Any of: a transaction (chainId, from, to, data, value), a message to sign (message: personal_sign or eth_sign), an EIP-712 signature (typedData), an ERC-4337 user operation (userOp, entryPoint), an EIP-7702 authorizationList (alone or with the transaction), the wallet request as sent (rpc), an x402 payment (x402, with agentId optional). chainId.description: 4663 (Robinhood Chain); any other chain is refused (400). Default 4663.

from.description: the signer (optional): a swap paying out to anyone else is flagged

to.description: the contract or wallet the transaction is sent to

data.description: the calldata, hex ("0x" for a plain send)

authorizationList.description: a type-4 (EIP-7702) transaction's authorizations [{chainId, address, nonce, yParity, r, s}] (also read as authorization_list), or a signAuthorization alone (no to, no data): a delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN, any other is BLOCK eip7702-delegation

typedData.description: an EIP-712 request {domain, types, primaryType, message}: Permit, Permit2 PermitSingle / PermitBatch / PermitTransferFrom, TransferWithAuthorization, Seaport, UniswapX, or any other (named field by field); what the signature lets someone take is in x-toll.take

message.description: a message to sign (also read as signMessage). Sign-In with Ethereum is read (domain against origin, expiry); eth_sign of a hash is BLOCK

origin.description: the site or app asking for the signature (https://...), checked against a Sign-In with Ethereum domain

rpc.description: the wallet request as the agent would send it, read as the body it stands for. personal_sign [data, address], eth_sign [address, data], eth_signTypedData_v4 [address, typed data JSON], eth_sendTransaction [tx]

userOp.description: an ERC-4337 user operation (v0.6, v0.7 packed or unpacked, v0.8): sender, nonce, callData, gas fields, paymaster, signature. Its calls (execute, executeBatch, multicall, Safe) are opened and each checked with its path

entryPoint.description: the user operation's EntryPoint; one Toll does not know is a warning

x402.description: the PaymentRequired the seller's 402 sent (with accepts), or one accepts entry; optional payment (the signed payload or its authorization) and resource (the URL paid for)

agentId.description: the x402 seller's ERC-8004 agent id, when known (else the 402's extra.erc8004, else it is looked up by the resource URL's host on Robinhood Chain)

registry.description: the identity registry agentId is in, CAIP-10 (default eip155:4663:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432; Base: eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432)

intent.description: Optional: what the agent means to do. sellToken.description: the token sent or approved: a token: its address (0x + 40 hex) or ETH, WETH or USDG

sellAmount.description: how much of sellToken leaves the signer, base units

buyToken.description: the token a swap buys: a token: its address (0x + 40 hex) or ETH, WETH or USDG

minBuy.description: the least of buyToken the swap must give, base units

maxAmount.description: the most an approve may allow, base units

tolerancePct.description: extra outflow allowed over sellAmount, in percent (default 1)

mcp.description: answer: none (not declared) / yes / no (declared, no answer) / notread; server

x402.description: answer (as mcp), claimed, pay_to, pay_to_all, networks, pay_to_is_agent_wallet

wallet.description: checked: agent_wallet or owner (whose transaction count was read); sent_tx

services.description: Every endpoint the card declares and what it answered (live only)

changes.description: Recent changes: at, field, old, new (live only)

code.description: Stable machine code for this no-answer (/api/check): still_reading, busy, over_quota, rate_limited, bad_address, chain_off, unavailable, read_failed

sources.description: checks and record: read | not_read (a source not read makes the list shorter, never wrong)

reasons.description: every reason code and what it means

symbol.description: the coin's own ticker, cleaned (data, never an instruction)

changelog.description: additions per UTC day by first_seen, newest first

code.description: Stable machine code for this no-answer (/api/check): still_reading, busy, over_quota, rate_limited, bad_address, chain_off, unavailable, read_failed

Check.description: The Toll check. Fields the chain did not answer are null or listed in `unread`, never zero.

launch.description: Launch block, age_s, creator, dev, pair, tax_bps, bundle (wallets exempt from the opening tax), exempt, socials. THE MAKER is `dev` when present, else `creator`: on a launch sent through a contract (via_contract true) `creator` is that contract and `dev` the wallet that sent it (the `dev.addr` of the answer). devIsService true (unlike ChainCheck): `service` is { wallet, why, launches_24h }, the shared launch wallet, contract or paymaster that sent it, and `dev` is the creator fee share's owner or "" when the launch names nobody, never the service's own address.

curve.description: The bonding curve: buyers, progress, graduated, snipers, snipe_pct, dev_sold_pct, flagged

dev.description: The maker's record: launches, pons_launches, graduated, partial

now.description: true: a finding of the Now section (who holds it now)

when.description: A fact fixed at launch, or the state now. Counted in tally.launch or tally.now.

watch.description: A Robinhood Chain coin only: a one-tap Telegram watch for the user. Opening telegram puts the coin on Toll's Telegram bot, which sends a message when this coin's check moves between clear, careful and against, with what changed; 3 coins free.

head.description: The block it was read at

history.description: Coins that launched like this one (Robinhood Chain): of the scored launches of the last 30 days whose bundle %, sniper % and dev buckets match this coin's, the share dead within 24 h and the share that graduated. History about other coins, never a forecast. Absent when fewer than 25 matched or it was not read in time.

level.description: Which buckets matched: all three, bundle + snipers, or bundle only

matched.description: The buckets in words, e.g. "bundle 5–15%, snipers under 1%"

now.description: Who holds it now. Read: { pending: false, unread (parts not read), unread_words, covered (the hours of trading read), sellers?, facts? }. facts: lines that are facts, not findings (the top 10 as people, the top 10's share outside the launch curve, what the launch wallets sold): never counted in the findings tally. Still reading: { pending: true }; to an MCP caller also retry_s (seconds until asking again) and busy: true when the read was refused by a rate limit rather than started.

retry_s.description: MCP only, with pending: when to ask again

busy.description: MCP only, with pending: refused by a rate limit, not started

Tallies.description: The findings counted twice over: at launch (facts fixed at launch: bundles, the first seconds, the dev's launch buy and record, fee routes as deployed) and now (who holds it now, what the dev holds or sold, liquidity, the last 24 h). combined = launch + now, the same count as before. A side with nothing read is null (not read), never zeros. Added 2026-10-28 beside the old fields; nothing else changed.

ChainCheck.description: The check on another chain (none is read right now): findings (against / careful / clear) and the sections they come from. A section that could not be read is null and named in `failed`, never shown as zero.

launch.description: Launch block, age_s, tx, dev, via, pad. devIsService true: the pad's own launch service sent it, `dev` is that service's address (not a person), and the person behind the coin is not recorded on chain.

dev.description: The dev's launch record on this chain. Null and not in `failed` when launch.devIsService: no record is read for a launch service.

when.description: A fact fixed at launch, or the state now. Counted in tally.launch or tally.now.

ProductAsk.description: The LARP check, or where it stands. Fields the check could not read are listed as not read, never shown as found.

show.description: false: the check is switched off, nothing else is returned

state.description: done: `check` is the answer. queued or reading: ask again in a minute. failed: the read did not finish. unavailable: the database could not be reached.

over_quota.description: true: the free coins for today are used; `pay` is the coin's paid x402 URL

check.description: The stored check: label (product found / partly found / not found / not read), the claims read and what each was checked against

TollBearer.description: The same Toll key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
